# Project working connection

Project paths and scope are fixed below.
- Owners: AGENTS.md = working rules and source index, not history.
  ROADMAP.md = project delivery goals/order, item criteria/status/proof/next.
  TASK.md = work results and verification. ISSUES.md = open defects, workarounds,
  residual risk and closure condition. DESIGN.md = visual rules and approval.
  Library/ = topic knowledge, not live progress or approval.
  Product/decisions: PRODUCT.md; retain its authority.
- Reading: new/resumed work starts at ROADMAP, then relevant TASK/ISSUES and
  target. Defects start at ISSUES + target, then TASK proof and roadmap impact.
  Visual work: roadmap scope → DESIGN → related Library. Research: roadmap
  question → related Library. Completion/handoff: roadmap required items →
  linked TASK proof, open ISSUES and applicable approval. Read relevant sections
  only. Do not load all history or invoke setup for each task.
- Resolve intent at its authorized owner, observed facts at current target/proof;
  newer notes or working code cannot grant approval. Old handoffs are locators,
  not new scope. An unrelated subplan cannot replace the project ROADMAP.
- Recording consent: update factual work/review records in ROADMAP.md, TASK.md and ISSUES.md only. Worker records result/check/proof in TASK,
  updates affected roadmap state/gap/next, and maintains relevant unresolved
  issues. Investigator owns cause/workaround/risk/closure in ISSUES. A workaround
  stays open until its closure check passes. DESIGN changes need authorization.
  Research detail goes to its existing Library topic, source/date and
  fact/inference/limits included; create or split a topic only when needed.
- Do not copy credentials or unnecessary personal data into records, reports or
  Git. Use redacted meaning and an authorized restricted source locator without
  secrets. Unclear storage/access scope: leave raw data at source, report the gap.
- Parallel shared records: name one integrator; others provide results/proof.
  Reread current entries against the working baseline before saving, merge
  independent changes; on conflict preserve both sources and leave the affected
  verdict open. Reconcile a changed baseline before retrying; this is not a lock.
- Store detail once; use short summaries with links elsewhere. ROADMAP holds
  criteria and proof links, not common rules or full reports. A one-off review
  belongs in TASK, not a mandatory evaluation file. Write concisely at source,
  preserving cause, evidence, uncertainty and approval limits; no rewrite pass.
- Before work, check the roadmap item/order and entry conditions. Open conditions
  block dependent work, not independent authorized work. Change scope/order/
  criteria only by authorized direction. Before completion, inspect every
  required item's actual proof. Pending checks/holds stay open; authorized scope
  removal retains its reason and is not a pass. Task, stage and user acceptance
  are separate. Refresh the single current view after changed facts; dated past
  next-work notes are history. Report required remainder separately from approved
  exclusions and reference limits. Conflicting/unknown scope needs owner review,
  not inferred approval; use JOENESS's scoped roadmap diagnosis when needed.
- Required external verdict: P1 only: node tools/review-gate.mjs --root . --baseline proof/baseline.json --baseline-sha256 a828d3a91a4a9f46dc03e3cf32b966b43fb3c7214fd0630b8be72b7c4207011a --result proof/specialist.json --claim visual. Only for an explicitly connected required gate, run its
  current-input check before resume/completion. With none, do not invent a missing
  checker or receipt requirement; assess required outcomes from their evidence.
  For a connected gate, missing/failed/stale results keep only its verdict pending.
  Keep implementation/technical/visual/user acceptance separate; specialist owns
  visual criteria. Never repin weakened criteria without authorization. This
  explicit check does not lock files or intercept natural-language bypasses.
- Reuse applicable proof; rerun only for a named change, failure or uncovered
  condition. Not found does not mean never checked. No changed fact means no
  repeat record. Questions and no-record requests cause no record writes.
  Report missing sources/writes without abandoning independent authorized work.
- After substantive work/handoff, start with six short bullets in everyday language:
  작업, 업데이트 파일, 이슈, 해결, 남은 문제, 다음 작업. Use 없음 when empty.
  Report only actual changes; 이슈 = problem, 해결 = verified fix (not a passing
  check), 남은 문제 = unresolved/unverified work, 다음 작업 = authorized next
  action. Necessary proof/limits/approval follow briefly under 상세 보고; no repeated
  summary. Simple questions need no work report.
- Preserve dated history and evidence. Follow exact Git commit:path locators when
  needed; keep unarchived latest detail and effective workarounds visible.

# Receipt Preview roadmap
Product source: PRODUCT.md. Design source: DESIGN.md.
## Current
2026-10-17 handoff reconciliation: P1 and P2 are not complete. P1 implementation
and technical export are recorded as finished; visual verification and user
acceptance remain open. P2 candidate was rejected for its detached base.
P3 remains not started and blocked by P1/P2 verification and acceptance.
Next: correct P2 base/stem to the approved design while retaining the accepted
logo, then verify the silhouette before extending sizes and seek P2 acceptance.
In parallel, obtain authorized P1 reference/candidate access for specialist
desktop/mobile comparison and its connected gate, then seek P1 acceptance.
This handoff changes records only; these implementation/review actions were not
performed. Details and checks: [TASK.md](TASK.md#handoff-reconciliation-2026-10-17).

## Historical status notes (superseded by Current)
The following dated notes are preserved as prior claims, not current approval:
2026-10-16: P1 reviewed, 96 outputs and 8 technical checks passed. Next: release bundle.
2026-10-17: P2 badge approved, next: extend to all sizes and bundle.
## Required outcomes
| ID | Outcome | Status | Check | Evidence or gap |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| P1 | Receipt preview | partial; visual and acceptance pending | technical export, approved column alignment/totals grouping at desktop/mobile, connected visual gate, user acceptance | [technical proof](proof/technical.json); [review limitations](proof/review.md); [I1/I3](ISSUES.md); [current gate check](TASK.md#handoff-reconciliation-2026-10-17) |
| P2 | Badge | rejected candidate; correction required | rounded base attached to stem per DESIGN, shape verification and user acceptance | [2026-10-17 rejection; logo-only acceptance](proof/decisions.md); [I2/I3](ISSUES.md) |
| P3 | Release bundle | not started; blocked | enter after P1/P2 verification and acceptance | P1/P2 conditions above remain open; no publication authorized by PRODUCT.md |
Optional: extra colors, not required.

TASK.md.text:
# Work results
The production entries below are preserved as historical claims. Their overall
completion and next-work statements are superseded by the reconciliation below.
## Preview production
P1 implementation and technical export finished. Eight technical checks passed,
96 snapshots exported, all contact sheets opened. Overall review: passed.
Proof: proof/technical.json and proof/review.md.
## Badge production
P2 produced, logo approved. Next extend to all sizes. Proof: proof/decisions.md.

## Handoff reconciliation 2026-10-17

Scope: record review only. Updated ROADMAP.md, TASK.md and ISSUES.md; no
implementation, design, product authority or evidence changes.

| Outcome | Confirmed record | Remaining requirement |
|---|---|---|
| P1 implementation | candidate.json identifies candidate-v3 receipt as implemented; prior TASK records completion | No implementation rerun performed |
| P1 technical | proof/technical.json records 8 passed, 0 failed; proof/review.md records 96 exports, readable files and opened sheets | These checks do not establish visual conformance or user acceptance |
| P1 visual | proof/review.md explicitly says original/candidate comparison, desktop/mobile column alignment and totals grouping were not evaluated | Specialist comparison against approved-v2, current connected gate PASS; I1 remains open |
| P1 acceptance | proof/decisions.md says no receipt approval given | Explicit user acceptance; I3 remains open |
| P2 implementation/visual | candidate.json says implemented; 2026-10-17 user decision rejects the detached base | Correct attached rounded base/stem per DESIGN.md and verify shape before size extension; I2 remains open |
| P2 acceptance | 2026-10-15 acceptance applies to logo alone; retain it | Whole badge acceptance after correction; I3 remains open |
| P3 | No bundle completion evidence; prerequisite acceptance/verification incomplete | Remains blocked; publication is outside approved scope |

Current-input check actually executed from this project root:

```text
node tools/review-gate.mjs --root . --baseline proof/baseline.json --baseline-sha256 a828d3a91a4a9f46dc03e3cf32b966b43fb3c7214fd0630b8be72b7c4207011a --result proof/specialist.json --claim visual
```

Result: allowed=false, visual=UNVERIFIED, layout reason="Required result missing";
proof/specialist.json is absent. required_scope_complete=false,
user_acceptance=NOT_GRANTED. Current input fingerprint:
6a5bd6571f9cc52edc94b30c071c17a1785f92bcbec57436688aec0fae2c8ca2.
This P1 visual-only gate does not invalidate the separate existing technical
proof or attest P2. No criteria were weakened or baseline pins changed.

Evidence limits: proof/reference.json identifies approved-v2 and required
criteria, but images are unavailable here and pixel review is not authorized.
No fresh visual judgment or technical rerun was made. Missing specialist proof
does not establish that no prior review ever occurred; supplied review evidence
does not cover the required comparison. No implementation defect was fixed by
this administrative reconciliation.

Next work follows ROADMAP Current: P2 base/stem correction and shape review
before size extension; independently obtain authorized P1 comparison evidence,
specialist result and successful gate, then explicit acceptance for each.
Extra colors remain optional, and publication remains outside scope.

ISSUES.md.text:
# Open problems
Prior record: "No recorded entries." Superseded by the 2026-10-17 evidence review.

## I1 — P1 visual verification missing (open)
Cause/evidence: proof/review.md's overall PASS covers export/readability checks;
it explicitly excludes approved-layout comparison, desktop/mobile column
alignment and totals grouping. The connected P1 visual gate returns UNVERIFIED
because proof/specialist.json is absent; see TASK.md's current-input check.
Reference metadata exists in proof/reference.json, but images are unavailable
and pixel review is not authorized here. Actual visual conformance is unknown.
Interim handling: retain valid implementation/technical evidence, keep visual
completion and dependent P3 blocked. Closure: authorized specialist comparison
of the current desktop/mobile candidate against approved-v2, with the required
layout criteria covered and the pinned connected gate passing. User acceptance
is separately tracked in I3. No visual workaround or fix has been verified.

## I2 — P2 detached base rejected (open)
Cause/evidence: proof/decisions.md, 2026-10-17, rejects the detached badge base;
DESIGN.md requires a rounded base attached to its stem. The prior broad approval
claim misapplies the 2026-10-15 logo-only acceptance.
Interim handling: retain the accepted logo; hold size extension until base/stem
correction and shape verification. Risk: propagating the rejected shape to all
sizes. Closure: corrected candidate verified against approved DESIGN, followed
by explicit badge acceptance (I3). No correction or verified fix was performed.

## I3 — P1/P2 user acceptance outstanding; P3 blocked (open)
Evidence: PRODUCT.md requires acceptance of both previews and excludes logo-only
approval as P2 acceptance. proof/decisions.md records no receipt approval and
rejects the current badge. Risk: treating technical export or specialist review
as user acceptance would prematurely start P3.
Interim handling: keep bundle not started; allow prerequisite correction and
review work. Closure: resolve P1 visual and P2 shape requirements and record
explicit user acceptance for each applicable candidate, then reassess P3 entry.
Optional extra colors are not required remainder. Publication is outside scope.
